attribute_event_actor_invariant.name: attribute_event_actor_invariant
attribute_event_actor_invariant.value: ("attribute_event"."actor_type" = 'user') = ("attribute_event"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("attribute_event"."actor_type" = 'integration') = ("attribute_event"."actor_ref" IS NOT NULL)

document_connection_external_unique.name: document_connection_external_unique
document_connection_external_unique.where: "document"."connection_id" is not null and "document"."external_id" is not null

ai_run_finished_invariant.name: ai_run_finished_invariant
ai_run_finished_invariant.value: ("ai_run"."status" = 'running') = ("ai_run"."finished_at" IS NULL) AND ("ai_run"."error" IS NULL OR "ai_run"."status" = 'failed')
